div.head: VI Atr 25
div.ab: And ordol ⁊ aðas syndon tocwedene freolsdagum ⁊ rihtymbrendagum ⁊ fram Adventum Domini oð octabas Epiphania ⁊ fram Septuagessima oð XV niht ofer eastron.
⁊ ordal ⁊ aþas ⁊ wifunga æfre syndan tocwedene heahfreolsdagum ⁊ rihtymbrenum ⁊ fram Adventum Domini oð octabas Epiphanige ⁊ fram Septuagessima oð XV niht ofer eastran.

And trial by ordeal, and [the rendering of] oaths, and marriages are always forbidden during festivals, and on legally appointed Ember days, and from the Advent till the Octave of Epiphany, and from the Septuagesima till fifteen days after Easter.

Und Ordal und [gerichtliche] Eide (und Hochzeiten K) sind stets untersagt an (hohen K) Feiertagen und gesetzlichen Quatembern und von Adventus Domini bis zur Octave Epiphaniae [13. Januar] und von Septuagesima bis 14 Tage nach Ostern.

And ordeals and [judicial] oaths (and weddings, K) are always forbidden on (high, K) feast-days and on the proper Ember days, and from Advent until the octave of Epiphany [13 January], and from Septuagesima until a fortnight after Easter.
div.note: K's ‘wifunga’ (weddings) is interpolated, also in the so-called Wulfstan homily, ed. Napier p. 117.
